_note: Disordered crystal fixtures for the demars-core test suite. All from the Crystallography Open Database (COD, https://www.crystallography.net) -- public domain (CC0), freely redistributable. NO ICSD data. 'complexity' groups single-mechanism (simple) vs multi-sublattice / split-site / coupled (complex). 'sites' = parsed non-P1 site count.

cod_1521474.cif.mechanism: aliovalent substitution + charge-compensating O vacancy (yttria-stabilized zirconia, fluorite)

cod_9003141.cif.mechanism: substitutional solid solution on the cation site ((K,Na)Cl halide)
cod_9003141.cif.role: engine reference (simple slot); also the README `demars run` quickstart.

cod_1010497.cif.mechanism: cation substitutional solid solution on two M sites ((Mg,Fe)2SiO4 olivine)

cod_1520848.cif.mechanism: mixed Fe/Ti cation site + vacancy (Fe-Ti oxide)

cod_4000330.cif.mechanism: split tunnel-K sites over partial positions + mixed-valence Mn framework (hollandite)
cod_4000330.cif.role: judgment-layer demo (README's `deaverage` example), NOT an engine reference. The engine alone leaves the split tunnel-O images unmerged -- the scalar --same-excl cutoff does not reach 1.26 A -- so the bare-engine representative carries ~100 O-O contacts below 2.0 A that the covalent-radius clash test cannot flag (O-O threshold is (0.66+0.66)*0.6 = 0.79 A, and 1.26 A reads as a legitimate O-O bond). Resolving it needs the analyst. Verified 2026-08-17 to be identical on the current engine and on b3a063b, so this is a standing property of the fixture, not a regression.

cod_9005182.cif.mechanism: multi-sublattice: partial Ca site + Mg/Al mixed tetrahedral sites (melilite)

cod_1544358.cif.mechanism: split O sites + oxygen-vacancy disorder + mixed-valence Fe (Sr-Fe oxide)
cod_1544358.cif.role: engine reference (complex slot). Split O sites + O vacancy, resolved cleanly by the engine alone: shortest contact is a real Fe-O bond at 1.86 A, no non-bonded contact under 2.0 A, and two independent runs agree bit-for-bit.
